rules.name: Templar Vows
rules.summary: Pick one Vow in round 1; it applies to Adeptus Astartes units all battle. Abhor the Witch: melee attacks on Psykers gain Precision; charges declared with an enemy Psyker within 12in may re-roll, but must end engaged with one. Accept Any Challenge: +1 to melee Wound rolls when attack S does not exceed target T. Suffer Not the Unclean: may charge after Falling Back; Pile-in/Consolidate moves need only end as close as possible to the nearest enemy unit. Uphold the Honour: Infantry on your objective at the end of your Command phase hold it until the opponent out-controls you, and may start Actions after Advancing.
